description: Defines the rx::Buffer11 class which implements rx::BufferImpl via rx::BufferD3D, including buffer management for Direct3D 11 in ANGLE project.

classes.name: Buffer11
classes.description: Implements Direct3D 11 buffer management for ANGLE, handling buffer storage, usage, and data updates.

methods.name: getBuffer
methods.description: Retrieves the D3D11 buffer object for a specified usage.

methods.name: getConstantBufferRange
methods.description: Gets a range of constant buffer data.

methods.name: getSRV
methods.description: Gets a shader resource view for the buffer.

methods.name: getRawUAVRange
methods.description: Gets an unordered access view for raw buffer data.

methods.name: markRawBufferUsage
methods.description: Marks the buffer as used for raw buffer operations.

methods.name: setSubData
methods.description: Updates a subset of the buffer data.

methods.name: map
methods.description: Maps the buffer for CPU access.

methods.name: mapRange
methods.description: Maps a range of the buffer for CPU access.

methods.name: unmap
methods.description: Unmaps the buffer after CPU access.

methods.name: markTransformFeedbackUsage
methods.description: Marks the buffer as used for transform feedback.
